facts.value: Receives a Fighter_GObj, returns false for a null object or null Fighter payload, and otherwise reads Fighter.motion_id to test equality with ftCo_MS_DeadUpFallHitCameraIce or ftCo_MS_Sleep. The inspected Dr. Mario pill, Fox Blaster and Ness-bat animation callbacks pass their stored fighter reference to this predicate. On true, they read the referenced fighter root JObj's Y scale and assign that scalar to all three axes of the item root JObj's scale; they do not copy the fighter's scale vector componentwise.
facts.rationale: The existing data-flow explanation obscures the uniform Y-scale broadcast. All three canonical callback helpers explicitly assign x, y and z from HSD_JObjGetScaleY, while the predicate itself only observes fighter motion.

evidence.why: Complete null checks, motion comparisons and boolean result.
Blaster callback gates uniform scaling from owner Y.
Bat callback uses the same Y-to-all-axes operation.
Pill callback and helper establish the same broadcast.
